name: Auto Weld Chassis and Components
old_description: Finding reliable, high-performance chassis products for a race car, pro street build, or custom street rod can be challenging. At Auto Weld Chassis, we make the process simple. With over 40 years of engineering and manufacturing experience, our team designs and fabricates premium chassis systems and custom suspensions that deliver proven performance on both the track and the street.
about:
Based in Danville, Pennsylvania, Auto Weld Chassis and Components has over 40 years of engineering and manufacturing experience in the racing and street performance industry. The company designs and fabricates premium chassis systems and custom suspensions for race cars, pro street builds, and street rods.

The shop produces a complete line of mandrel-bent frame rails, chassis kits, housings, and suspension components, including 4-link and ladder bar suspensions, front-end assemblies, and Featherweight OEM front suspensions. Auto Weld is vertically integrated, with most products manufactured in-house, allowing for a wide variety of custom specifications. Every part is crafted from top-grade materials by skilled technicians familiar with the extreme demands of competitive motorsports.

The company serves a worldwide customer base in drag racing, street performance, and classic car markets. Its race-tested designs have powered numerous drag racing winners and award-winning street-legal vehicles featured at NHRA and other national events. Customers range from individual builders to professional race teams seeking chassis and suspension systems for lightweight dragsters or street-ready pro cars.

Auto Weld emphasizes American-made quality and competitive pricing, adjusting for material cost fluctuations. The vertical integration model ensures higher quality control and the ability to meet custom specifications, which the company cites as key differentiators from competitors. Products are tested on both street and track, and have been featured in magazines and on television.
